title: Raviart--Thomas Elements with Geometric Correction for Distorted Quadrilateral Meshes
summary: Mixed finite element methods based on Raviart--Thomas spaces are widely used for the numerical approximation of second--order elliptic problems in flux form. On quadrilateral meshes, however, the bilinear mapping from the reference element introduces a spatially varying Jacobian, which may violate the inclusion property $\mathrm{div}\,V_h \subset W_h$ for the standard Raviart--Thomas spaces. In this paper we propose a simple modification of the classical Raviart--Thomas elements on quadrilateral meshes.
